# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left side.
- **System Information Bar**: Located at the top center, shows "Oct 23 02:21" with a bell icon indicating notifications.
- **Window Control Buttons**: On the top right, includes minimize, maximize, and close buttons.
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" is visible on the top left, indicating the GNOME desktop environment.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: From left to right: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help.
- **Active Menu**: The "File" menu is currently highlighted, indicating it is selected or hovered over.

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Icons (Top to Bottom)**:
  - **Chrome Browser Icon**: Google Chrome.
  - **Email Client Icon**: Thunderbird email client.
  - **Visual Studio Code Icon**: The VS Code logo.
  - **Media Player Icon**: VLC media player.
  - **Document Editor Icon**: LibreOffice Writer.
  - **Spreadsheet Icon**: LibreOffice Calc.
  - **Presentation Icon**: LibreOffice Impress.
  - **Graphics Editor Icon**: GIMP.
  - **File Manager Icon**: Nautilus file manager.
  - **Software Center Icon**: Ubuntu Software.
  - **Help Icon**: Question mark icon.
  - **Trash Icon**: Recycle bin.
- **Bottom Icons**:
  - **Grid Icon**: Application launcher grid.
  - **User Icon**: User profile.
  - **Gear Icon**: Settings with a notification badge (number 1).

## Explorer Panel

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER" at the top.
- **Project Folder**: "PROJECT" is expanded, showing the following files:
  - `README_text_search.md`
  - `README_todo.md`
  - `test_text_search.py`
  - `test_todo.py`
  - `text_search.py`
  - `todo.py`
- **Additional Controls**: Three dots (`...`) are visible to the right of the "EXPLORER" title, likely for more options.

## Main Content Area

- **Welcome Tab**: The "Welcome" tab is open, indicated by the tab label and an "X" to close it.
- **Main Title**: "Visual Studio Code" in large font.
- **Subtitle**: "Editing evolved" in smaller font below the main title.
- **Start Section**:
  - **Options**:
    - "New File..."
    - "Open File..."
    - "Open Folder..."
    - "Connect to..."
- **Recent Section**:
  - Text: "You have no recent files."
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - **Title**: "Walkthroughs"
  - **Content**:
    - "Started with VS Code" with a description: "Organize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding."
    - "The Fundamentals" with a description: "Learn the fundamentals."

## Trust Folder Dialog

- **Dialog Title**: "Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?"
- **Icon**: A blue shield with a keyhole.
- **Description Text**:
  - "Code provides features that may automatically execute files in this folder."
  - "If you don't trust the authors of these files, we recommend to continue in restricted mode as the files may be malicious. See our docs to learn more."
  - Path: "~/project"
- **Checkbox**:
  - "Trust the authors of all files in the parent folder 'user'"
- **Buttons**:
  - "No, I don't trust the authors" (gray button) — "Browse folder in restricted mode"
  - "Yes, I trust the authors" (blue button) — "Trust folder and enable all features"

## Bottom Status Bar

- **Settings Checkbox**: "Show welcome page on startup" is checked.
- **Status Indicators**: Three icons with numbers (0, 0, 0) indicating no errors, warnings, or other statuses.
- **Notification Icon**: A bell icon in the bottom right corner.
